arguments.issue: Does the claimant have a well-founded fear of persecution based on his sexual orientation?
arguments.claim: The claimant fears persecution and death threats from a powerful politician due to their secret homosexual relationship and subsequent harassment.
arguments.quote: The claimant ended this relationship with XXXXX because he was not proud of deceiving XXXXX. XXXX was offended and started harassing the claimant... A few days later, the police called the claimant to tell him that XXXX had been killed... XXXXX called the claimant on his cellphone to warn him that he knew where he was... XXXXX called him again... he said that it was his last chance to go back to him; if he refused, he would kill him that same day... XXXXX called him on his cellphone again and warned him that he was going to kill him within 24 hours... Fearing for his life, the claimant left his country on XXXXX, 2008... The claimant testified that he still fears XXXXX because he is convinced that this individual will kill him as soon as he returns to Mexico.

support.ref: claimant testimony about relationship and threats
police call and identification of body
phone calls from XXXXX threatening claimant

arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the claimant's fear is not credible or that the state protection was adequate.

arguments.issue: Is the claimant's fear of persecution linked to his sexual orientation?
arguments.claim: The claimant's fear arises from his homosexual relationship with a politician and the resulting threats after ending the affair.
arguments.quote: The claimant alleged that he is homosexual and that his problems with his lover began in XXXX 2008... He had been in a romantic relationship with XXXX since XXX 2006... A month later, they became lovers and started having a secret affair because of XXXXX high social standing in the community... XXXX was offended and started harassing the claimant... The claimant warned XXXXX that if he did not leave him alone, he would reveal the cards, gifts and photographs that XXXXX had given him... The claimant wanted to report XXXXX threats to the police, but he changed his mind when they made fun of him after he told them that XXXX was his lover... XXXXX called the claimant on his cellphone to warn him that he knew where he was... XXXXX called him again... The claimant testified that he still fears XXXXX because he is convinced that this individual will kill him as soon as he returns to Mexico.

support.ref: claimant testimony about sexual orientation and relationship
threats linked to ending the homosexual relationship

arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the threats are personal or criminal, not related to sexual orientation.
